reasoning: A clear, unmistakable silhouette of open scissors. It is the ideal icon for tasks about haircuts and barbershop visits, buying or maintaining scissors/shears, and physical cutting in crafts, sewing, couponing, or household chores. The main trap is figurative or non-scissor uses of the verb 'cut' (cutting budgets, cutting sugar, cutting lawn grass).
